method: Complete native text of all physical pages for the 20 negatives, including exact repeated blocks and administrative pages; targeted visual inspection where layout could change interpretation. Supplemental literal passages are conference notes, not changes to reference_evidence.
negative_evaluation_scope: PDF-target / scoped only; cross-bula absence has not been established over the complete corpus.
